verdict.rationale: Metorial's Magic MCP servers give a hosted MCP endpoint that Metorial manages. Sessions return a `connection_url` for any MCP client, and portals let users copy a standard MCP URL into clients such as Cursor, ChatGPT and Claude, so downstream tools are reachable without self-deployed infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an MCP client actually connecting to a hosted Metorial URL.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure

citations.quote: A Magic MCP server gives you a hosted MCP endpoint for a provider. Metorial manages the server and makes the provider's tools available through one connection.
Returns a `connection_url` you can connect an MCP client to
copy a standard MCP URL for their AI client
